snippet.title: Alpha Nomos - Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Pick up your instrument, feel the beat, and fight your way through a world undone by music. 

Move in sync with the rhythm, turn weapons into instruments, and reshape both your combat and the soundtrack as you push deeper into the chaos.

🎵 Beat-synced action combat
🎪 Corrupted toys and abandoned circus arenas
🎭 Branching upgrades that evolve the soundtrack in real time
🥁 Live-recorded instruments as weapons
🎮 Roguelite runs through advancing arenas

Play the demo now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2529960/Alpha_Nomos/

Join the RibCage Games Discord to share feedback, find other players, chat with the developers, and keep up with the latest Alpha Nomos updates.
Discord: https://discord.gg/9APWhV4aBr
